Inventory service logs confirming Redis timeout errors during the incident window
candidates.statement: Redis reserve_inventory calls from inventory time out (~2s), causing inventory 503, order ReadTimeout, and gateway /v1/checkout 502s; gateway p95 for /v1/checkout is ~2406ms, matching the ~2s dependency timeouts.
candidates.uncertainty: Traces show Redis timeouts but no Redis-side telemetry is available to confirm the underlying cause (saturation, network, or config).

report.explanation: Traces consistently show redis.reserve_inventory timeouts (~2s) in inventory, propagating as inventory 503, order ReadTimeout, and gateway /v1/checkout 502s; gateway p95 for /v1/checkout is ~2406ms. Deployment record only shows gateway v1.0.0 baseline and does not establish causation. Redis-side telemetry is missing, so the bounded candidate is redis-timeout.
